verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own marketing page says it can connect to external tools via MCP and use documents, tasks, and data from other apps as context. That is a direct, product-native MCP-client capability. However, it rests on a single marketing line with no help-center detail on adding arbitrary or custom MCP servers, configuring them, or the agent invoking server tools rather than just pulling context. missing for 10: documentation of how to add or configure arbitrary MCP servers, evidence of tool invocation beyond context ingestion, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect to external tools via the MCP, allowing you to work with documents, tasks, and data from other apps as context for your app or prototype.
